hŏnestĭtūdo , ĭnis, f. honestus,
I.honorableness, virtue (ante-class. for honestas, II.): tua honestitudo Danaos decipit diu, Att. ap. Non. 121, 1 (Trag. Fr. v. 501 Rib.): “horrida Europae,” id. ib. 120, 31 (Fragm. Tr. v. 16 Rib.).
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
